_comment: Frozen RFC-0007 §10 port debt. The gate fails if any count RISES; lower it by fixing violations, then re-run --write-baseline. Every entry must carry a reason and a phase in the migration playbook.

SP-0007.due: per service, before that service enters Phase 2
SP-0007.why_frozen_and_not_fixed_here: SP-0007 is an ADVISORY cross-check; the authoritative ratchet is inboxxhq-infra scripts/check-service-addressing.py, and ARCH-0010 gates the application-code half. Lowered 296 -> 24 on 2026-08-30 by deleting every entry whose owning service's code provably no longer reads it: 12 of the 15 services had already migrated to servicediscovery/grpcx and their manifests were simply still setting variables nothing consumed. The 24 that remain are READ by running code -- call-routing-service (4 vars), org-service (USER_SERVICE_BASE_URL) and order-service (STRIPE_ADAPTER_SERVICE_URL) -- so deleting them would drop each to a localhost default in a cluster. They come out per service, in this order and not before: migrate the code to resolve by logical name, release, promote to all four environments, THEN delete the manifest entry. That is RFC-0007 §11 atomicity, and platform-identity-service is what skipping it looks like.

_notes: SP-0012 closed 2026-08-30. Its entry was NOT deleted because the debt was written off: preprod and prod both pin sha256:f474fc84 (commit a02b5dc7), which reads PORT, so the HTTP_PORT pair the entry protected had become the pure legacy its own DELETE-WHEN comment described. The condition was checked against the gitops digest in overlays/*/kustomization.yaml, not the release ledger -- releases/*.json still records a02b5dc7 as ['dev','staging'] and would have said preprod was un-promoted. The digest is what the cluster runs.\n\nSP-0013..SP-0019 are deliberately absent from `controls` below. They were added the same day with the fleet already conformant, so their baseline is 0 and any finding fails the lane. A new control that lands pre-baselined at its current violation count is a control that never fails on the day it would have mattered.
